recentItems.title: Battlefield 6: Official Launch Live Action Trailer
recentItems.description:
Heart-pounding action. High-intensity combat. Destruction like you have never seen it before.

Our Hero squad goes head to head with the Pax Armata threat as they storm a war torn New York City on the brink of collapse.

This is all-out warfare. This is Battlefield 6. Deployment begins October 10.

recentItems.title: Play Split Fiction on Nintendo Switch 2!
recentItems.description:
Jump into mind-blowing moments and experience the many worlds of Split Fiction, available now on Nintendo Switch™ 2! 

In this boundary-pushing co-op adventure from the studio behind It Takes Two, you'll master a variety of abilities and overcome diverse challenges while jumping between sci-fi and fantasy worlds.

Invite a friend to play online for free with Friend's Pass, now with cross-play*! As long as one of you owns the game, both of you can play.

recentItems.title: Split Fiction | Friend Edition Unboxing
recentItems.description:
Wish you had a friend to play Hazelight’s new co-op Split Fiction with? Say hello to Split Fiction: Friend Edition! 

The world’s first game to ship with a real life friend.

Or, probably a lot easier, find a friend on our discord: discord.gg/hazelight  

Already got a friend? Good for you! You can invite them for free with the Friend's Pass* to enjoy the entire adventure together! And remember, cross-play is enabled so you can play with someone on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, or PC.  

Learn about Split Fiction Friend Edition: https://www.ea.com/games/split-fiction/split-fiction/features/friend-edition

*Friend’s Pass requires installation of the Friend’s Pass, persistent internet connection and applicable platform account. One user must own the full game in order for the co-op player to play the full game.

recentItems.title: Split Fiction | Official Story Trailer
recentItems.description:
Learn about the power of friendship in Split Fiction™, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure from Hazelight Studios, the masterminds behind It Takes Two.

Pre-order now: https://www.ea.com/games/split-fiction/split-fiction  

The heroes of Split Fiction, Mio and Zoe, don’t get along at first, but soon enough they become each other’s only hopes. This journey will throw unexpected twists at them and if they want to make it through, they’ll need to have each other’s backs. 

Playing as Mio or Zoe, you'll encounter bizarre situations as the two traverse stories born from their own wild imaginations. Most importantly – they’ll face it all together.
